card.summary: 2.6B flow DiT with a Gemma-2 LLM encoder; strong text-image alignment and a distinctive system-prompt mechanism for setting style/role. Multilingual.
card.pick_when: Strong text alignment, multilingual prompts, or system-prompt-driven style control.

prompt.guidance: Uses a SYSTEM PROMPT prepended to the user prompt. Default: 'You are an assistant designed to generate superior images with the superior degree of image-text alignment based on textual prompts or user prompts.' Swap it to set role/style (e.g. 'You are a professional photographer.').
prompt.example: (system) You are a professional photographer. (user) A serene Japanese garden in autumn with a red maple, stone lantern, and koi pond reflecting the sky, soft morning light, highly detailed
prompt.overview: ~2B flow-matching Next-DiT with a Gemma-2-2B encoder: detailed natural-language prose; the official demo prepends a system prompt for best image-text alignment.
prompt.instructions: Use descriptive natural-language prose; long, detailed prompts are supported. The official demo prepends a system prompt to your caption (cap = system_prompt + cap). The default system prompt is: 'You are an assistant designed to generate high-quality images with the highest degree of image-text alignment based on textual prompts.' -- prepend it to match official behavior (it can be customized to steer overall style/theme, or left empty). Recommended: guidance_scale ~4.0, 30-50 steps, cfg_trunc_ratio ~0.25, cfg_normalization True; default max_sequence_length 256 (raise for long prompts). Negative prompts are supported but only take effect when guidance_scale > 1 (empty by default).
do: Prepend the official system prompt for best image-text alignment (or customize it)
dont: Rely on booru tags instead of prose
Set guidance_scale <= 1 if you want negatives to take effect
examples: Upper body of a young woman in a Victorian-era outfit with brass goggles and leather straps. Background shows an industrial-revolution cityscape with smoky skies and tall metal structures.
A serene photograph capturing the golden reflection of the sun on a vast expanse of water; the sun at top center casts a shimmering trail of light across the rippling surface
prompt.negative_guidance: Supported via negative prompt, but effective only when guidance_scale > 1 (empty by default).

negative.note: Supported; cfg_trunc settings matter more than heavy negatives.

speed.measured_note: ~91s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 50 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe it in a sentence or two. This model also understands other languages.
